en: Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 7.11. Sekkhattika (The Triplet on the State of Training)

Dependent on a state that is not of the Learners (na-sekkha) …pe… dependent on a state that is not of the Non-Learners (na-asekkha) …pe… dependent on a state that is neither of the Learners nor of the Non-Learners (na-neva-sekkha-nāsekkha) … (Abbreviated.

Under the root condition (hetu), twenty-nine; under the object condition (ārammaṇa), twenty-four …pe… under the repetition condition (āsevana), seventeen …pe… under the non-disappearance condition (avigata), twenty-nine.
